caption: A close, handheld view sweeps over murky greenish water, where broken star-shaped sunlight glints and pale sky reflections shift continuously with the ripples. Several rainbow-colored streaks drift and deform across the frame, moving with the jitter of the camera rather than sitting fixed on the surface. The water churns gently throughout, relocating the bright sparkles and soft reflection patches from one moment to the next. From the left edge a human hand enters, holding a white plastic spray bottle capped with a blue nozzle. The hand and bottle remain at the left margin for a stretch of the clip, drifting slowly upward as the view pans. Toward the final frames the hand slips out of sight, while the white bottle remains at the left edge.
relations: Water ripples -> continuous shifting of broken sunlight glints and pale sky reflections across the frame.
Camera jitter -> drift and deformation of rainbow-colored streaks moving across the water surface.
Hand entering from left holding white spray bottle -> slow upward drift during camera pan.
Hand slipping out of sight -> white bottle remains at the left edge.
